spec.law: service_cycles = PV_START + max(P0, P1, R) + 16 + 33 (kv_static_programme.attention_calendar, STRETCH=1: R = SERVICE_END - 49 - PV_START)
agrees: qkd_ahub_static_dw fr at PV_START + R + FR_OFS (pvfin R slot)
disagreed: qkd_attn_result_face_s c_last = max(P0,P1) (face expected beat 0 at 913 @T=256 / 1639 @T=8192 vs 1745)
qkd_pv_fin_s: join age max(P0,P1) and cal_bad for R > max(P0,P1)+8 -> every STRETCH=1 command would fault at start_pv

tx_first: fixed 1750 is the compiler schedule (attn_kv priced at the worst context, constant per layer); a T-dependent TX_FIRST would make the D2D RESULT slot context-dependent, which the static link calendar does not have. L0 window = F7 (QXF-LINK).
